limitations: This is a hypothetical worked case for research and compiler demonstration. It does not describe, test, certify or authorize a real vehicle, model or operation.

Hypothetical frozen airborne vision-cue detect-and-avoid perception release

assumptions.text: The road encounter is inside the stated ODD, including speed, roadway geometry, weather, illumination and sensor-health limits.
The aircraft encounter is inside a stated airspace, traffic, weather, sensing-range and operating-rule envelope.
The airborne sensor, fusion and preprocessing configuration matches the configuration represented by the training and evaluation evidence.
After a late track or detection result, the aircraft has enough remaining separation, maneuver authority and dynamic margin to reach a safe state.

A monitor has an evidence-backed, adequately independent traffic-and-clearance observation path, or an operational restriction that prevents a shared missed-aircraft failure or unsafe escape maneuver from becoming unrecoverable.
Changes to learned weights, sensor configuration, fusion, alerting, maneuver logic or operational domain trigger a new release and impact assessment.
The sensor and preprocessing configuration matches the configuration represented by the training and evaluation evidence.
The vehicle retains enough maneuver authority and time after a late perception result to reach a safe state under the stated dynamics bounds.
A monitor observes a signal that distinguishes a missed hazard from an empty scene early enough to intervene, or operation is restricted so that this distinction is not required.
No change to data, labels, model weights, preprocessing, sensor hardware, planner, monitor or ODD is made without a new release and impact assessment.

hazards.title: An occluded road actor is missed or detected too late, leaving the vehicle without a safe avoidance maneuver.
An approaching aircraft is missed or tracked too late, leaving insufficient separation or maneuver margin to avoid a collision.

risk_contexts.title: Road encounter risk context
risk_contexts.risk_statement: The residual risk of a missed or late-detected road actor cannot be judged from an aggregate detection metric alone; it depends on encounter exposure, severity, sensing, delay, action authority and recovery assumptions.
risk_contexts.metric_limit: A held-out or simulated metric is conditional on its scenario distribution, threshold and system model. It is evidence for this context, not a safety score or component failure rate.

risk_contexts.title: Airborne encounter risk context
risk_contexts.risk_statement: The residual collision risk of a missed or late track requires an encounter-specific argument linking severity, airspace/traffic exposure, sensing, alerting delay, maneuver margin, recovery and operating restrictions.
risk_contexts.metric_limit: A risk ratio or aggregate encounter result can conceal a harmful encounter class; it must retain its event definitions, encounter distribution, mitigations and stated scope.

obligations.title: Bound operating scope and authority
obligations.description: Define the encounter, ODD, hazardous outcome, decision authority and time/maneuver margin for this release.

obligations.title: Sensor and input observability
obligations.description: Establish observable conditions, sensing limits, latency, calibration and common-cause failures for the release configuration.

obligations.title: Learning and release lineage
obligations.description: Trace data, labels, splits, learning configuration, frozen weights and deployment transformations to this release. Record label policy, capture-group splits, candidate selection, underfit/overfit checks and access to held-out verification data for the vision-cue role.

obligations.title: Hazard-relevant performance and uncertainty
obligations.description: Evaluate false negatives, delay and uncertainty by stated scenario partitions, including shifted conditions and the action when uncertainty exceeds authority limits. Distinguish the image cue from a usable motion/clearance estimate and preserve performance by independently held-out encounter class.

obligations.title: Closed-loop planner and controller behavior
obligations.description: Show how perception error reaches planning, actuation and vehicle dynamics, including the last recoverable state.

obligations.title: Useful intervention and recovery
obligations.description: Demonstrate monitor observability, switching delay, recovery authority and the safe envelope; leave a blocker if the monitor shares the missed perception path.

obligations.title: System and operational composition
obligations.description: Validate failure propagation, sensor disagreement, other actors, safety conflicts and the boundary between model evidence and operating authorization.

obligations.title: Release change and in-service control
obligations.description: Bind retraining, data, sensor, model, planner, monitor and ODD changes to impact analysis, renewed evidence and a new release identity.

obligations.title: Bound airborne operating scope and authority
obligations.description: Define airspace/traffic assumptions, collision hazard, authority, alerting threshold and maneuver/separation margin for this release.

obligations.title: Airborne sensor and fusion observability
obligations.description: Establish sensing range, latency, fusion disagreement, weather/background limits and common-cause failures for the airborne release.

obligations.title: Airborne learning and release lineage
obligations.description: Trace data, labels, training configuration, frozen weights, fusion configuration and deployment transformation to this release. Record label policy, capture-group splits, candidate selection, underfit/overfit checks and access to held-out verification data for the vision-cue role.

obligations.title: Encounter performance and uncertainty
obligations.description: Evaluate missed/late tracks, uncertainty and alerting performance by encounter partition and shifted sensing condition. Distinguish the image cue from a usable motion/clearance estimate and preserve performance by independently held-out encounter class.

obligations.title: Airborne closed-loop maneuver behavior
obligations.description: Show how perception/fusion error propagates through alerting, avoidance planning, aircraft dynamics and separation outcome.

obligations.title: Useful airborne intervention and recovery
obligations.description: Demonstrate monitor observability, an evidence-backed independent traffic-and-clearance path for an active escape maneuver, alert/switching delay, recovery maneuver authority and the last safe intervention state. A later landing or diversion plan does not satisfy this immediate collision-avoidance obligation.

obligations.title: Airborne system and operational composition
obligations.description: Validate sensor disagreement, other traffic, aircraft/system failure propagation and the distinct equipment, installation, aircraft and operational approval edges.

obligations.title: Airborne release change and in-service control
obligations.description: Bind changes to models, sensors, fusion, alerting, avoidance logic and operating domain to renewed evidence and release identity.
